row: At CuraCore, we believe in strong, scientific, evidence-based education in the fields of medical acupuncture, medical massage, botanical medicine, photomedicine for both human and veterinary healthcare providers.  We also encourage wellness among our students, partners, and peers.

emails.context: n this video, Dr. Jolynn Chappell, one of our exotic animal faculty members, instructs students about acupuncture safety for reptiles. Questions? Email us at info@curacore.org. Visit our website at CuraCore.org/VET. NOTE: DO NOT TREAT EXOTICS UNLESS YOU ARE A VETERINARIAN WITH ADDITIONAL EDUCATION IN EXOTIC ANIMAL HANDLING AND SAFETY MEASURES.
